changelog:
* **fix: empty denomination rows looked disabled** (795bcb1)
  - Show the ghost zero, chevron hint and zero subtotal in clear colors.
  - Replace 0.3f-0.45f onSurface alphas with full-alpha onSurfaceVariant.
  - Empty rows now read as ready to fill, not as disabled controls.
  - Value states keep their primary container colors unchanged.
* **fix: misaligned notes hint in save dialog** (a50195c)
  - Replace the hand-drawn ghost hint with the field's native placeholder.
  - M3 lays the placeholder out in the same slot as the typed text.
  - Remove the Box overlay and manual 16dp offset guess.
  - Hint still shows while the box is empty, focused or not.
* **fix: replaying count-up on scroll and tab switch** (3bed644)
  - Track the last animated total in rememberSaveable state.
  - Survives LazyColumn item disposal and nav tab state save/restore.
  - Count-up now runs only when the grand total actually changes.
  - Returning to the dashboard snaps to the current total silently.
* **fix: quantity picker empty state looked disabled** (e2d4a9f)
  - Show the stepper zero in full onSurface color instead of 35% alpha.
  - Zero is a real state (no notes counted), so it no longer reads as disabled.
  - Keep minus and OK buttons functionally disabled while no value is set.
* **fix: flickering scrollbar on variable-height lists** (6b7a548)
  - Derive the lazy-list thumb geometry from the real visible span.
  - Average item height is now the actual first..last visible item span.
  - Replace the viewport-height guess that resized and jumped the thumb.
  - Skip drawing when no items are visible.
  - Clamp the estimated scroll position to the valid range.
* **fix: reversed sub-screen push-in animation** (8d8221a)
  - Slide new screens in from the right edge, matching Android's push pattern.
  - slideInHorizontally previously used its default offset, entering from the left.
  - Back navigation already exits to the right, so forward/back now feel symmetric.
